Title: a combo feat. Rebekka, Chantry Elder of Munich

Messages.Author: jeroen rombouts
Messages.Body:
In a previous post someone said that second round combat lacks bite. This
got a friend of mine thinking and ha came up with a (IMO nice) combo that
can only be beaten by IG and lots of maneuvres. (card texts below)

I dont know if this works - hell I don't even know if its legal!
confirmation please - does any one have an idea?

first round: majesty or catatonic fear + Telepatic Tracking (I know that it
negates CF's damage)

Second round: (manuevres to get range close) + Blood to water + superior CF

+ repeat if needed.

Best vamps to pull this off: Rebekka, Chantry Elder of Munich and Kemintiri
(both have PRE, THA and aus/AUS)
Others: Salinger, Klaus van der Veken, Bindusara, Historian of the Kindred ,
Gwendolyn (PRE, tha)
+ a number of tremere with pre

text:
Telepathic Tracking: Combat, Auspex, 1 blood
Press, only usable to continue combat. If another round of combat occurs,
this vampire gets an optional maneuver during that round.
(S) Only usable when both combatants are still ready and combat is about to
end (with no uncancelled press to continue). Combat does not end; another
round starts.

Blood to Water: Combat, Thaumaturgy, 2 blood
Only usable at close range, before strike resolution. Opposing vampire burns
3 blood or opposing ally is burned. Not usable during the first round of
combat. (S) As above, but opposing vampire burns 5 blood.
